Field.Name: Name
Field.CoreBonusHint: Up to 50 creation points are automatically applied first to Knowledge and the archetype's other core skill.

SkillDescription.agility: Agility governs balance, movement, riding, evasion, and other feats of bodily control.
SkillDescription.care: Care covers crafts, treatment, leadership, trade, extracts, and practical professional work.
SkillDescription.entertainment: Entertainment covers performance, music, dance, storytelling, and games of chance.
SkillDescription.faith: Faith governs religious knowledge, invocations, divine power, and access to Holy Tablets.
SkillDescription.fighting: Fighting governs armed and unarmed combat, defensive reactions, and battle experience.
SkillDescription.knowledge: Knowledge covers languages, cultures, learning, religion, lore, and scholarly insight.
SkillDescription.shadowArts: Shadow Arts covers stealth, disguise, theft, traps, and covert observation.
SkillDescription.vitnerCraft: Vitner Craft governs perceiving, calling, and shaping vitner through spells and Vitner Tablets.
SkillDescription.wilderness: Wilderness covers travel, survival, hunting, navigation, nature, and seafaring.

KnowledgeDescription.strenuous: Strenuous lets the conjurer spend 2 additional Vitner Points per specialty level to gain +1 SV per amount spent when weaving a spell.

Roll.OpenInitiative: Initiative uses 1d10 with an open roll on 10.

Seax.Name: Seax (Dagger or Knife)
Seax.Description: A ubiquitous single-edged knife used for work, ritual blood gifting, throwing, and as a last-resort weapon.

Glaaf.Name: Glaaf (Short Sword)
Glaaf.Description: A short sword, usually double-edged, common in eastern Trudvang and associated with the ancient Brots.

HringSeax.Name: Hring Seax (Ring Knife)
HringSeax.Description: A Mittlander fighting blade with a single inward-curving edge and a ring at the pommel, often tied to the wrist.

BattleAxe.Name: Barda Axi (Battle Axe)
BattleAxe.Description: A refined and enlarged hand axe designed for combat.

Broadsword.Name: Breid Swerd (Broadsword)
Broadsword.Description: A robust cutting sword, commonly wielded by Mittlander warriors and sometimes used as a paired weapon.

BeardedAxe.Name: Villtur Axi (Bearded Axe)
BeardedAxe.Description: A long-shafted Stormlander axe whose L-shaped blade widens the cutting surface without excessive weight.

LongSpear.Name: Spjot (Long Spear)
LongSpear.Description: An effective and inexpensive long spear, especially dangerous in disciplined formations or from horseback.

TwoHandedAxe.Name: Tvei Axi (Two-Handed Axe)
TwoHandedAxe.Description: A mighty two-handed axe. Fine examples use iron for both shaft and head.

TwoHandedSword.Name: Tvei Swerd (Two-Handed Sword)
TwoHandedSword.Description: A huge, heavy sword that sacrifices speed for reach, power, and terror on the battlefield.

HuntingBow.Name: Veidi Bogi (Hunting Bow)
HuntingBow.Description: A simple hunting bow. It deals full damage at short range and half damage at long range.

Longbow.Name: Lang Bogi (Longbow)
Longbow.Description: A heavy, composite Stormlander war bow with greater range and a more dangerous open damage roll.

Crossbow.Name: Krossbogur (Crossbow)
Crossbow.Description: A powerful defensive crossbow with excellent range but a slow loading cycle.

FurLeather.Name: Fur / Leather Armor
FurLeather.Description: Warm, quiet armor of tanned fur or soft leather. It is common among Wildfolk, troll peoples, and northern humans.

HardenedLeather.Name: Hardened Leather Armor
HardenedLeather.Description: Leather boiled in oil and formed to the wearer. It is quieter than metal armor and offers moderate protection.

ChainMail.Name: Chain Mail
ChainMail.Description: Thousands of interlinked metal rings worn over padding. Mail is heavy but comparatively flexible.

PlateArmor.Name: Plate Armor
PlateArmor.Description: Rare, custom-fitted overlapping metal plates. Plate offers exceptional protection at severe weight and initiative cost.

SmallShield.Name: Small Wooden Shield
SmallShield.Description: A quick shield allowing three weapon actions per round. Shields are used primarily to parry successful melee attacks.

MediumShield.Name: Medium Wooden Shield
MediumShield.Description: A balanced shield allowing two weapon actions per round. On a successful parry, damage is applied to the shield.

LargeShield.Name: Large Wooden Shield
LargeShield.Description: A slow but highly protective shield allowing one weapon action per round.

AdventureKit.Name: Adventure Kit
AdventureKit.Description: A bundle of common expedition supplies. Make a Situation roll with a value of 10 to determine whether an ordinary kit contains a plausible item.

Rope.Name: Hemp Rope
Rope.Description: A practical length of hemp rope for climbing, binding, hauling, and camp work.

Torch.Name: Torch
Torch.Description: A resinous wooden torch providing portable light until consumed.

DragonBlood.Name: Dragon Blood
DragonBlood.Description: A legendary altering extract taken from a dragon. It is exceedingly rare and worth about 1,000 silver coins per dose.
DragonBlood.Effect: Roll 1d20 + extract Strength - Constitution. Mild, moderate, substantial, and complete effects grant +2, +4, +8, or +12 natural Protection Value for one day.

FrostboarFat.Name: Frostboar's Fat
FrostboarFat.Description: Thick brown fat cut from a frostboar's neck. It smells terrible and can be used without further preparation.
FrostboarFat.Effect: Rubbed on the body, the fat protects against extreme cold and heat for two hours. Determine its degree with the extract-effect roll.

WoundBalm.Name: Wound-Balm
WoundBalm.Description: A healing salve prepared for direct application to injuries.
WoundBalm.Effect: Apply the balm to a wound and resolve its healing degree with the standard extract-effect roll.

Manetter.Name: Manetter
Manetter.Description: A dangerous poison that slowly strangles its victim and ignores armor and natural protection.
Manetter.Effect: Roll 1d20 + 2 - Constitution and consult the Extract Effect table. Damage is removed directly from Body Points.

AnimalVitner.Name: Animal Vitner Tablet
AnimalVitner.Description: A Vitner Tablet concerned with speaking to, calling, controlling, possessing, and sending messages through animals.

FlameCraft.Name: Flame Craft Tablet
FlameCraft.Description: A Vitner Tablet governing sparks, heat, fire protection, flame control, and devastating seas of fire.

PowerThought.Name: Power of Thought Tablet
PowerThought.Description: A Vitner Tablet governing language, courage, fear, telepathy, memory, control, possession, and mind reading.

TabletShield.Name: Tablet of the Shield
TabletShield.Description: A Holy Tablet of the Tenet of Nid whose divine feats concern shelter, endurance, and protection.

Messenger.Name: Messenger
Messenger.Description: Imbues a small animal with a simple message and a destination it can reasonably reach.
Messenger.Effect: The animal attempts to travel to the named recipient and deliver the message. Extra levels of power can extend the message or distance.

SpeakAnimals.Name: Speak to Animals
SpeakAnimals.Description: Allows the enchanter to understand and communicate with a nearby animal.
SpeakAnimals.Effect: For the duration, the caster can exchange simple ideas with animals; intelligence and disposition still limit the conversation.

CallAnimals.Name: Call on Animals
CallAnimals.Description: Calls animals of a chosen general kind from the surrounding area.
CallAnimals.Effect: Nearby animals may travel toward the caster. Extra levels of power increase range, number, or duration as approved by the game master.

Spark.Name: Spark
Spark.Description: Creates a focused magical spark capable of igniting suitable tinder.
Spark.Effect: Ignites a small combustible target within range. It is not a full combat flame unless enhanced by levels of power.

BurningHand.Name: Burning Hand
BurningHand.Description: Wraps the caster's hand in searing magical flame for a close attack.
BurningHand.Effect: The touched target suffers magical fire damage determined by the spell's level of power; ordinary protection may be limited by the game master.

FlameBurst.Name: Flame Burst
FlameBurst.Description: Hurls a compact burst of flame that detonates at the selected point.
FlameBurst.Effect: Targets in the burst suffer fire damage. Additional levels of power can increase damage or area.

Courage.Name: Courage
Courage.Description: Strengthens a creature's mind against dread.
Courage.Effect: Reduces Fear Points or grants a bonus against fear for the duration, according to the spell's level of power.

Fear.Name: Fear
Fear.Description: Projects a terrifying thought directly into a target's mind.
Fear.Effect: The target gains Fear Points; Psyche and other protections may reduce the effect.

ArmedFighting.Name: Armed Fighting
ArmedFighting.Description: A Fighting discipline covering combat with manufactured weapons. Each level contributes +1 in applicable actions.

OneHandLight.Name: One-Handed Light Weapons
OneHandLight.Description: An Armed Fighting specialty. Each level contributes +2 when fighting with one-handed light weapons and adds locked Combat Points.

ShieldBearer.Name: Shield Bearer
ShieldBearer.Description: An Armed Fighting specialty. Its first level removes the normal shield-hand penalty when using shields; further levels improve shield use.

BattleExperience.Name: Battle Experience
BattleExperience.Description: A Fighting discipline covering combat awareness, initiative, armor use, and tactical maneuvers.

BodyControl.Name: Body Control
BodyControl.Description: An Agility discipline covering balance, controlled movement, evasion, and ambidexterity.

Horsemanship.Name: Horsemanship
Horsemanship.Description: An Agility discipline covering riding, mounted movement, and mounted combat.

HealingDrugs.Name: Healing and Drugs
HealingDrugs.Description: A Care discipline covering diagnosis, healing, extracts, poisons, potions, and treatment.

DivinePower.Name: Divine Power
DivinePower.Description: A Faith discipline that grants divinity capacity and access to Holy Tablets and divine feats.

VitnerShaping.Name: Vitner Shaping
VitnerShaping.Description: A Vitner Craft discipline used with Galding, Sejding, or Vyrding specialties to weave spells.

Survival.Name: Survival
Survival.Description: A Wilderness discipline covering prolonged travel, shelter, weather, food, and life beyond settled lands.

ExtractEffect.Name: Extract Effects
ExtractEffect.Substantial: Substantial effect (11-15), followed by moderate and mild
ExtractEffect.Complete: Complete effect (16-20), followed by each lower effect

FearLevel.Name: Fear Levels
FearLevel.One: Fear level 1 (1-10): uneasy, no universal modifier
FearLevel.Two: Fear level 2 (11-20): frightened, -1 SV and initiative
FearLevel.Three: Fear level 3 (21-30): horrified, -3 SV and initiative
FearLevel.Four: Fear level 4 (31-40): terrified, -5 SV and initiative
FearLevel.Five: Fear level 5 (41-50): petrified, -7 SV and initiative

DisciplineCost.Name: Discipline and Specialty Costs
DisciplineCost.One: Level 1: requires base SV 4; costs 7 points
DisciplineCost.Two: Level 2: requires base SV 7; costs 14 points
DisciplineCost.Three: Level 3: requires base SV 7; costs 21 points
DisciplineCost.Four: Level 4: requires base SV 10; costs 28 points
DisciplineCost.Five: Level 5: requires base SV 10; costs 35 points

FatalMagic.Name: Fatal Magic Effects
FatalMagic.E21: The enchanter becomes lethargic and apathetic, suffering -2 on everything for 1d3 hours.
FatalMagic.E23: The enchanter loses 1d10 Vitner Points from their capacity (minimum 1) for 1d3 hours.
FatalMagic.E25: The enchanter suffers -2 on everything and loses 1d10 Vitner Points from their capacity (minimum 1) for 1d3 hours.
FatalMagic.E29: The enchanter suffers -2 on everything and loses 1d10 Vitner Points from their capacity (minimum 1) for 1d6 hours.
FatalMagic.E31: The enchanter loses 1d10 (OR 9-10) Vitner Points from their remaining capacity (minimum 1) for one day.
FatalMagic.E33: The failed spell absorbs vitner within 1d10 (OR 10) meters. Each creature loses 1d3 Vitner Points; creatures without Vitner Points instead lose that many Body Points.
FatalMagic.E35: A vitner enclosure surrounds the enchanter. Within 10 meters of another enchanter it flashes for 1d6 damage that ignores non-magical armor, losing equal strength until emptied.
FatalMagic.E37: The failed spell absorbs vitner within 1d10 (OR 10) meters. Each creature loses 1d6 Vitner Points; creatures without Vitner Points instead lose that many Body Points.
FatalMagic.E39: The enchanter loses one third of their vitner capacity for 1d3 days and suffers a visual negation (1d10): 1-2 bark skin; 3-4 doubled finger length; 5-6 grass hair; 7-8 local-animal fur; 9 the closest person suffers 1-8; 10 everyone within 10 meters suffers 1-8.
FatalMagic.E41: A vitner enclosure surrounds the enchanter. Within 20 meters of another enchanter it flashes for 1d6 damage that ignores non-magical armor, losing equal strength until emptied.
FatalMagic.E43: The failed spell absorbs vitner within 1d10 (OR 10) meters. Each creature loses 1d10 Vitner Points; creatures without Vitner Points instead lose that many Body Points.
FatalMagic.E44: A vitner enclosure surrounds the enchanter. Within 50 meters of another enchanter it flashes for 1d6 damage that ignores non-magical armor, losing equal strength until emptied.
FatalMagic.E45: The enchanter loses half their vitner capacity for 1d6 days and suffers a visual negation (1d10): 1-2 bark skin; 3-4 doubled finger length; 5-6 peat-moss hair; 7-8 local-animal fur; 9 the closest person suffers 1-8; 10 everyone within 10 meters suffers 1-8.
FatalMagic.E46: The enchanter becomes vitner-blind and cannot evoke spells for 1d6 days. Within 1d10 (OR 10) meters, each creature loses 1d6 Vitner Points; creatures without Vitner Points instead lose that many Body Points.
FatalMagic.E47: A vitner enclosure surrounds the enchanter. Everyone within 1d10 (OR 10) meters is hit for 1d10 damage that ignores non-magical armor; each discharge drains 1d3 Vitner Points from the enclosure until emptied.
FatalMagic.E48: The enchanter loses their memory for 1d3 days and cannot evoke spells or perform skills.
FatalMagic.E49: A harmless light explosion empties the enchanter of vitner. Capacity drops to 1 and starts recovering after one week.
FatalMagic.E50: A vitner enclosure surrounds the enchanter. Everyone within 1d10 (OR 9-10) meters is hit for 1d10 damage that ignores non-magical armor; each discharge drains 1 Vitner Point until emptied.
FatalMagic.E51: The enchanter and every creature within 2d6 meters suffer 1d10 damage that ignores non-magical armor. The enchanter loses half their remaining Vitner Points and recovery starts after one week.
FatalMagic.E52: The enchanter suffers Body Point damage equal to the spell's total vitner cost, falls unconscious for 1d10 minutes, and drops to 1 vitner capacity; recovery starts after one week.
FatalMagic.E53: A blinding discharge forces everyone within 2d6 meters to pass a Psyche-modified Situation roll against 10 or go blind for 1d5 minutes. The enchanter suffers damage equal to the spell's vitner cost, falls unconscious for 1d10 (OR 9-10) minutes, and drops to 1 capacity; recovery starts after one week.
FatalMagic.E54: The enchanter suffers a minor stroke, takes 2d10 (OR 10) damage, and falls into a coma for 1d10 days.
FatalMagic.E55: The enchanter suffers damage equal to the spell's vitner cost and falls unconscious for 1d10 (OR 7-10) minutes; everyone within 2d6 meters suffers half that damage. Capacity drops to 1 and recovery starts after two weeks.
FatalMagic.E56: The enchanter suffers a severe stroke, takes 2d10 (OR 9-10) damage, loses one Intelligence step, and falls unconscious for 1d10 days.
FatalMagic.E57: An enormous negation absorbs 1d10 (OR 6-10) Body Points and empties all vitner. Capacity drops to 1 and recovery starts after two weeks.
FatalMagic.E58: The enchanter opens a fog portal to Bloodheim, which devours them.
FatalMagic.E59: The enchanter becomes a lightning orb that explodes after 2d6 action rounds. Everything within 50 meters suffers 1d10 (OR 7-10) Body Point damage; the enchanter disappears.
FatalMagic.E60: The enchanter becomes a black-energy orb that explodes after 1d6 action rounds. Everything within 100 meters suffers 1d10 (OR 5-10) Body Point damage and everything within 300 meters suffers half; the enchanter disappears.

FatalFailure.Name: Fatal Failure Effects
FatalFailure.E21: The dimwalker loses touch with spiritual power for 1d6 minutes and cannot use Divinity Points.
FatalFailure.E31: The dimwalker loses touch with spiritual power for 1d6 hours and cannot use Divinity Points.
FatalFailure.E36: The dimwalker loses the knowledge and ability to invoke 1d3 random abilities for 1d6 days.
FatalFailure.E41: The dimwalker loses the knowledge and ability to invoke the attempted ability for 2d6 days.
FatalFailure.E46: The dimwalker loses the knowledge and ability to invoke 1d3 random abilities for 2d6 days.
FatalFailure.E51: The dimwalker loses touch with spiritual power for 1d6 days and cannot use Divinity Points.
FatalFailure.E55: The gods permanently revoke the attempted ability; it will always fail.
FatalFailure.E57: The gods permanently revoke 1d3 random accessible abilities; they will always fail.
FatalFailure.E59: The god permanently refuses to grant the dimwalker any divine abilities.
FatalFailure.E60: The gods immediately destroy the blasphemer and revoke their very existence.

Galtir.Name: Galtir
Galtir.Description: A brutish tusked humanoid. This standard specimen has 23 Body Points, Dexterity -1, Intelligence -4, and Strength +2.

GiantSnake.Name: Giant Snake
GiantSnake.Description: A massive serpent with crushing coils, Hylja camouflage, and a paralyzing stare. Standard specimen: 95 Body Points.

GiantSpider.Name: Giant Spider
GiantSpider.Description: An ancient colossal spider able to throw webs, paralyze prey, and cocoon victims. Standard specimen: 95 Body Points.

Gryphon.Name: Gryphon
Gryphon.Description: A huge winged hunter combining an eagle's head and wings with a feline body. Standard specimen: 87 Body Points.

NightUlm.Name: Night Ulm
NightUlm.Description: A small winged blood-drinker whose numbing saliva can spread the dreaded rugtanne infection. Standard specimen: 25 Body Points.

ThornBeast.Name: Thorn Beast
ThornBeast.Description: An immense flying beast whose stench alone can inflict Fear Points. Standard specimen: 171 Body Points.

TrollBull.Name: Troll Bull
TrollBull.Description: A hulking Haminges-worshiping humanoid with horns, natural armor, and a devastating charge. Standard specimen: 58 Body Points.

Warg.Name: Warg
Warg.Description: A fast predatory quadruped whose bite can spread warg sickness. Standard specimen: 18 Body Points.

DeepBellow.Name: Deep Bellow
DeepBellow.Description: The galtir unleashes a violent bellow; nearby creatures may need to resist fear or distraction.

Fearless.Name: Fearless
Fearless.Description: The creature is unusually resistant or immune to ordinary sources of Fear Points.

Constricting.Name: Constricting (SV 10)
Constricting.Description: After surrounding a victim, the snake tightens its coils. The victim must break free or suffer crushing consequences.

ParalyzingStare.Name: Paralyzing Stare
ParalyzingStare.Description: The victim makes a Psyche-based Situation roll with Situation Value 6 or is paralyzed for 1d3 action rounds.

AttackWeb.Name: Attack Web (SV 9)
AttackWeb.Description: Throws a broad sticky web. A trapped victim needs a Strength-based Situation roll, usually against Situation Value 7, to break free.

AttackAbove.Name: Attack From Above
AttackAbove.Description: The gryphon exploits flight and momentum to strike from above before climbing away.

Bloodsucker.Name: Bloodsucker
Bloodsucker.Description: Once attached, the night ulm drains blood in subsequent rounds and may expose a human victim to disease.

TerrifyingStench.Name: Terrifying Stench
TerrifyingStench.Description: Creatures within 5 meters gain 1d10 open Fear Points from the overwhelming smell unless accustomed to it.

Charge.Name: Charge
Charge.Description: The troll bull begins combat with a horn-first rush capable of knocking victims down and increasing damage.

TrollHeart.Name: Troll Bull Heart
TrollHeart.Description: The creature's brutal vitality and protective rage make it exceptionally difficult to stop.

WargSickness.Name: Warg Sickness
WargSickness.Description: A bitten human may contract a transformative disease. A Constitution- and Psyche-based Situation roll is commonly required to resist it.

vitner-animal-vitner:messenger:0.Name: Messenger
vitner-animal-vitner:messenger:0.Summary: By singing a special song, the mage can use creatures nearby to pass on a message.

vitner-animal-vitner:speak-to-animals:1.Name: Speak to Animals
vitner-animal-vitner:speak-to-animals:1.Summary: This spell creates a spiritual link between the mage and a chosen animal within 50 meters.

vitner-animal-vitner:call-on-animals:2.Name: Call on Animals
vitner-animal-vitner:call-on-animals:2.Summary: Calls nearby animals of a chosen kind to gather around the mage.

vitner-animal-vitner:conjure-ravens:3.Name: Conjure Ravens
vitner-animal-vitner:conjure-ravens:3.Summary: This spell conjures a murder of ravens that flaps, swirls, and caws around the target.

vitner-animal-vitner:control-animals:4.Name: Control Animals
vitner-animal-vitner:control-animals:4.Summary: The mage can control and direct one or more unintelligent animals.

vitner-animal-vitner:mind-of-the-wolf:5.Name: Mind of the Wolf
vitner-animal-vitner:mind-of-the-wolf:5.Summary: The one affected by the spell gains something that resembles a wolf ’s ability to tell subtle differences in smells, such as fear, aggressiveness, anxiety , and strength.

vitner-animal-vitner:possess-animals:6.Name: Possess Animals
vitner-animal-vitner:possess-animals:6.Summary: This spell enables a mage to transfer their consciousness into an intelligent vertebrate’s body.

vitner-animal-vitner:create-messenger:7.Name: Create Messenger
vitner-animal-vitner:create-messenger:7.Summary: The mage creates a messenger of flesh and blood, which can deliver its message to a predetermined destination.

vitner-animal-vitner:send-message:8.Name: Send Message
vitner-animal-vitner:send-message:8.Summary: The mage creates a vitner being that has a single purpose: to deliver a message to intelligent creatures of the mage’s choosing.

vitner-body-vitner:grip:0.Name: Grip
vitner-body-vitner:grip:0.Summary: This spell changes the vitner flowing through the enchanted character’s hands and feet so their skin becomes more coarse and adhesive.

vitner-body-vitner:tipping:1.Name: Tipping
vitner-body-vitner:tipping:1.Summary: Unbalances a creature so that it falls to the ground.

vitner-body-vitner:hearing-deafness:2.Name: Hearing/Deafness
vitner-body-vitner:hearing-deafness:2.Summary: This spell can increase the hearing of the enchanted for the duration.

vitner-body-vitner:sense-of-smell:3.Name: Sense of Smell
vitner-body-vitner:sense-of-smell:3.Summary: This spell can temporarily increase the enchanted person’s sense of smell.

vitner-body-vitner:vision-blindness:4.Name: Vision/Blindness
vitner-body-vitner:vision-blindness:4.Summary: This spell can increase the vision of the enchanted for the duration.

vitner-body-vitner:leather-skin:5.Name: Leather Skin
vitner-body-vitner:leather-skin:5.Summary: This spell alters a creature’s skin, which thickens to the hardness and durability of leather.

vitner-body-vitner:immobilize:6.Name: Immobilize
vitner-body-vitner:immobilize:6.Summary: This spell creates a prohibitive energy that immobilizes a chosen victim.

vitner-body-vitner:appearance-change:7.Name: Appearance Change
vitner-body-vitner:appearance-change:7.Summary: This spell’s energy creates an imbalance in the enchanted character’s body , which results in an immediate change of their physical appearance.

vitner-body-vitner:strengthen:8.Name: Strengthen
vitner-body-vitner:strengthen:8.Summary: This spell increases the enchanted character’s muscles, which immediately grow both in size and power.

vitner-body-vitner:hasten:9.Name: Hasten
vitner-body-vitner:hasten:9.Summary: This spell alters the enchanted character’s flexibility and reflexes, which immediately become nimbler and more agile.

vitner-body-vitner:imprison:10.Name: Imprison
vitner-body-vitner:imprison:10.Summary: The spell is an extension of the spell Immobilize, which means that the enchanter must first successfully immobilize the victim through that spell before attempting to weave this one.

vitner-body-vitner:change-creature:11.Name: Change Creature
vitner-body-vitner:change-creature:11.Summary: The vitner that the spell brings forth is powerful enough to turn a living creature into the form of an entirely different one.

vitner-delusion-vitner:roar:0.Name: Roar

holy-thuuldom-stoneshape:stoneshape:0.Summary: The Thuul and his gear seem to melt into the mountain when the rune is activated.

holy-thuuldom-well-of-water:well-of-wate.Name: Well of Water
holy-thuuldom-well-of-water:well-of-wate.Summary: The Thuul places the rune-inscribed object on the stone and creates a temporary source of mountain water in that location.

holy-toikalokke-animal-mind:animal-frien.Name: Animal Friend
holy-toikalokke-animal-mind:animal-frien.Summary: Forest animals that are not sick or under magical control never willfully attack the chosen one, but instead respectfully walk away.

holy-toikalokke-animal-mind:animal-track.Name: Animal Tracks
holy-toikalokke-animal-mind:animal-track.Summary: Whenever the Ihana chooses, they can leave the tracks of an animal when treading instead of their own prints.

holy-toikalokke-animal-mind:talk-to-anim.Name: Talk to Animals
holy-toikalokke-animal-mind:talk-to-anim.Summary: The Ihana can communicate with animals.

holy-toikalokke-animal-mind:invisible-to.Name: Invisible to Animals
holy-toikalokke-animal-mind:invisible-to.Summary: The chosen one can, when desired, become completely invisible to unintelligent animals.

holy-toikalokke-animal-mind:animal-spiri.Name: Animal Spirit
holy-toikalokke-animal-mind:animal-spiri.Summary: The Ihana can become a reflection of their chosen animal, granting the dimwalker some of the animal’s personality and traits.

holy-toikalokke-animal-mind:animal-maste.Name: Animal Master
holy-toikalokke-animal-mind:animal-maste.Summary: The Ihana can domesticate a wild animal or beast, getting it to act like a tame farm cat.

holy-toikalokke-animal-mind:animal-shape.Name: Animal Shape
holy-toikalokke-animal-mind:animal-shape.Summary: The Ihana obtains a visible picture of the person or creature that trod the current path by examining its tracks, and can then follow those tracks without a problem.

holy-toikalokke-lynx-power:orientation:0.Name: Orientation
holy-toikalokke-lynx-power:orientation:0.Summary: The spell makes it possible for the enchanter to find designated objects within the range.

holy-toikalokke-lynx-power:tree-walk:1.Name: Tree Walk
holy-toikalokke-lynx-power:tree-walk:1.Summary: The Ihana can move among the trees at half their normal movement rate.

holy-toikalokke-lynx-power:hearing:2.Name: Hearing
holy-toikalokke-lynx-power:hearing:2.Summary: By concentrating on a visual point within the designated range, the Ihana is able to hear everything within 10 meters of that point.

holy-toikalokke-lynx-power:feline-leap:3.Name: Feline Leap
holy-toikalokke-lynx-power:feline-leap:3.Summary: The Ihana has the ability to leap with the incredible agility and grace of a feline.

holy-toikalokke-lynx-power:feline-reflex.Name: Feline Reflexes
holy-toikalokke-lynx-power:feline-reflex.Summary: The Ihana evades an incoming ranged attack.

holy-toikalokke-lynx-power:aim:5.Name: Aim
holy-toikalokke-lynx-power:aim:5.Summary: When the Ihana attacks with ranged weapons, they can take extra aim at a target for the duration of the ability , gaining an additional +1 to the SV to strike the target.

holy-toikalokke-lynx-power:track:6.Name: Track
holy-toikalokke-lynx-power:track:6.Summary: The Ihana obtains a visible picture of the person or creature that trod the current path by examining its tracks, and can then follow those tracks without a problem.

holy-toikalokke-lynx-power:concealment:7.Name: Concealment
holy-toikalokke-lynx-power:concealment:7.Summary: The Ihana is able to blend in and become one with the background as desired for the duration of the ability.

holy-toikalokke-lynx-power:forest-path:8.Name: Forest Path
holy-toikalokke-lynx-power:forest-path:8.Summary: The Ihana can move through the forest at double their normal movement rate.

holy-toikalokke-lynx-power:pathfinder:9.Name: Pathfinder
holy-toikalokke-lynx-power:pathfinder:9.Summary: The Ihana can travel through otherwise impassable forest or shrubbery when desired.

holy-toikalokke-master-of-elements:earth.Name: Earth Wall
holy-toikalokke-master-of-elements:earth.Summary: The Ihana causes a wall of earth to shoot up from the ground for protection.

holy-toikalokke-master-of-elements:contr.Name: Control Fire
holy-toikalokke-master-of-elements:contr.Summary: The elf can control fire to a limited extent.

holy-toikalokke-master-of-elements:purif.Name: Purify Water
holy-toikalokke-master-of-elements:purif.Summary: The spell filters water and removes all dangerous and unhealthy substances from up to 10 liters of liquid.

holy-toikalokke-master-of-elements:gift-.Name: Gift of Water
holy-toikalokke-master-of-elements:gift-.Summary: The Ihana feels right at home in the water, as if it were their natural environment (allowing the character to swim even without the Swim specialty).

holy-toikalokke-master-of-elements:fire-.Name: Fire Tamer
holy-toikalokke-master-of-elements:fire-.Summary: The Ihana can create or extinguish up to 1 cubic meter of fire per action round, within the designated range.

holy-toikalokke-master-of-elements:shape.Name: Shape Earth
holy-toikalokke-master-of-elements:shape.Summary: The Ihana can transform 1 cubic meter of earth into mud and then shape it according to their will.

holy-toikalokke-master-of-elements:eleme.Name: Elemental Arrow
holy-toikalokke-master-of-elements:eleme.Summary: Forms an arrow of elemental force and hurls it at a chosen target.

holy-toikalokke-master-of-elements:earth.Name: Earthquake
holy-toikalokke-master-of-elements:earth.Summary: The spell causes an area within the range to rumble with a single, heavy tremor.

holy-toikalokke-master-of-elements:sprin.Name: Spring of Water
holy-toikalokke-master-of-elements:sprin.Summary: The Ihana can cause a spring of cold, fresh water to emerge from the ground (the game master decides whether the conditions are too extreme to allow this).

holy-toikalokke-master-of-elements:contr.Name: Control Wind
holy-toikalokke-master-of-elements:contr.Summary: The spell creates a blast of compressed air that rushes with incredible speed at one or more targets.

holy-toikalokke-master-of-elements:hot-a.Name: Hot and Cold
holy-toikalokke-master-of-elements:hot-a.Summary: The Ihana can control the temperature.

holy-toikalokke-master-of-elements:fire-.Name: Fire Resistant
holy-toikalokke-master-of-elements:fire-.Summary: Protects the recipient from heat, flame, and supernatural fire.

Theme.vitner-animal-vitner: Magic for communicating with, summoning, controlling, possessing, and carrying messages through animals.
Theme.vitner-body-vitner: Magic that alters bodies and senses, restrains creatures, and enhances speed, strength, or resilience.
Theme.vitner-delusion-vitner: Illusions that manipulate sound, appearance, concealment, landscapes, silence, and invisibility.
Theme.vitner-dimvitner: Death magic that speaks with, summons, controls, dismisses, or drains the undead and the powers of Dimhall.
Theme.vitner-flame-craft: Fire magic that creates heat and flame, protects against fire, and controls conflagrations.
Theme.vitner-perceiving: Divinations for finding places, beings, objects, undead, routes, and the surrounding terrain.
Theme.vitner-power-of-thought: Mental magic affecting language, courage, fear, memory, telepathy, control, possession, and thought reading.
Theme.vitner-power-of-vision: Sight magic for tracking, remote observation, astral travel, reading vitner, and seeing truth.
Theme.vitner-soil-craft: Earth magic that moves or shapes soil and stone, creates tremors and quagmires, and petrifies creatures.
Theme.vitner-vitner-craft: Metamagic for channeling, enchanting, sealing, tracing, dispelling, and blocking vitner.
Theme.vitner-vitner-of-objects: Magic that identifies, protects, binds, alters, creates, locks, or destroys objects.
Theme.vitner-water-craft: Water magic for finding, purifying, creating, shaping, solidifying, and walking upon water or waves.
Theme.vitner-wind-craft: Air magic that purifies air, creates fog and wind, grants lift or protection, and summons storms.
Theme.vitner-witchcraft: Curses and maladies that bring fever, amnesia, plague, blighted harvests, and hostile trees.
Theme.holy-gerbanis-influence-of-jorn: Powers of darkness, deathly winds, storm-born steeds, protection, and Jorn's supernatural influence.
Theme.holy-gerbanis-power-of-enken: Powers granting courage, will, soul sight, night vision, and increasingly mighty storm armor.
Theme.holy-gerbanis-strength-of-stormi: Battle blessings that grant giant strength, commanding voices, divine guards, and heroic warriors.
Theme.holy-gerbanis-warmth-of-sunvei: Solar powers of healing, warmth, light, summer, hunting, and restoration.
Theme.holy-gerbanis-wisdom-of-windinna: Powers of inspiration, truth, creativity, mental resolve, protection, and Windinna's insight.
Theme.holy-gerbanis-wrath-of-tyrd: War powers of fiery weapons, terrifying cries, battle fury, firestorms, and victory.
Theme.holy-ealdtradition-gift-of-thanja: Nature powers for animal speech and shapes, concealment in the wild, and communion with forest beings.
Theme.holy-ealdtradition-halawen-s-offering: Ancestral protections against fear, bloodfangs, hostile vitner, and supernatural assault.
Theme.holy-ealdtradition-heritage-of-majne: Heroic draughts and royal blessings for slaying trolls, giants, and dragons and rallying warriors.
Theme.holy-ealdtradition-magh-s-gift: Songs and bonds that aid travel, riders, harvests, heroes, and the changing seasons.
Theme.holy-ealdtradition-nema-s-usefulness: Powers that sharpen animal senses, reveal trails, remove restraints, and hasten journeys.
Theme.holy-ealdtradition-tribute-of-morgu: Blood-fueled battle powers that provoke rage and unleash volleys, fire, and murderous fury.
Theme.holy-tenetnid-tablet-of-anger: Sacred powers of blood, stone, martyrdom, destructive bolts, bursts, and divine purging.
Theme.holy-tenetnid-tablet-of-grace: Merciful powers that heal, restore life and memory, recall allies, and preserve them from death.
Theme.holy-tenetnid-tablet-of-the-knight: Knightly blessings that empower armor, spears, authority, sacred weapons, and holy battle forms.
Theme.holy-tenetnid-tablet-of-the-shield: Protective powers that create sanctuaries, barriers, resistance, banishment, and safe passage.
Theme.holy-tenetnid-tablet-of-the-sun: Solar signs and sacred radiance that protect homes and groves, reveal omens, and illuminate darkness.
Theme.holy-tenetnid-tablet-of-voices: Powers of speech, hearing, fellowship, sanity, divine favor, and binding sacred pacts.
Theme.holy-haminges-power-of-the-beast: Bestial powers granting predator instincts, tusks, claws, fur, endurance, and animal transformation.
Theme.holy-haminges-power-of-the-dragon: Draconic powers granting constriction, flame resistance, paralyzing sight, scales, and serpent forms.
Theme.holy-haminges-power-of-men: Mortal and dwarven arts of mastery, weapon skill, healing draughts, smithing, and legendary achievement.
Theme.holy-haminges-power-of-the-scale: Lindwurm powers of terror, regeneration, stone limbs, petrification, and monstrous resilience.
Theme.holy-haminges-power-of-the-thurses: Troll and thurse powers granting icy hides, immense strength, breath weapons, and destructive rage.
Theme.holy-haminges-power-of-trolls: Troll powers of disease, illusion, persuasion, fearlessness, cunning, and mountain enchantment.
Theme.holy-toikalokke-animal-mind: Powers for befriending, tracking, speaking with, mastering, and assuming the forms of animals.
Theme.holy-toikalokke-lynx-power: Feline gifts of hearing, leaping, reflexes, aim, tracking, concealment, and pathfinding.
Theme.holy-toikalokke-master-of-elements: Elemental powers controlling earth, fire, water, wind, temperature, and elemental projectiles.
